item.title: [security] Google Rolls Out DBSC in Chrome 146 to Block Session Theft on Windows
item.description: Google has&nbsp;made Device Bound Session Credentials&nbsp;(DBSC) generally available to all Windows users of its Chrome web browser, months after&nbsp;it began&nbsp;testing the security feature in open&nbsp;beta.
